entries.zh: 新增中英文版本说明草稿：比较上一已发布正式版本与当前提交，按功能归纳变化，并保留提交依据。生成结果校验格式和引用范围；API 方式可在 Actions 中手动运行。
entries.en: Generate bilingual release-note drafts from the last published stable release to the current commit, grouped by functionality with commit evidence. Validate the output format and evidence range. The API workflow is available as a manual Actions run.

entries.zh: 支持使用本机 ChatGPT 登录的 Codex 自动生成草稿，无需 API Key。安装定时器后每十分钟检查默认分支，有新提交时生成并归档至 automation/release-notes；同一提交不重复生成，失败后一小时重试。
entries.en: Support automatic drafts through locally authenticated Codex with ChatGPT login, without an API key. The installed timer checks the default branch every ten minutes, generating and archiving new revisions to automation/release-notes. Completed revisions are skipped and failures retry after one hour.

entries.zh: 新增本机定时任务与手动 API 工作流的配置说明，涵盖认证要求、草稿位置、状态检查、停用和失败恢复。维护者流程明确要求审核草稿后再纳入正式版本说明。
entries.en: Add setup guides for the local timer and manual API workflow, covering authentication requirements, draft locations, status checks, disabling the timer and failure recovery. The maintainer guide requires draft review before inclusion in official release notes.

entries.zh: 双臂新增 FDCC 和笛卡尔阻抗遥操，支持左右手柄独立启停；默认仍为 ServoP。
entries.en: Add dual-arm FDCC and Cartesian impedance teleoperation with independent left/right Grip control. ServoP remains the default.

entries.zh: 增加阻尼、跟随倍率、直接跟随和阻抗关节参考限速选项，补充操作指南。
entries.en: Add damping, response gain, direct-target and impedance joint-reference speed options, with updated operating guides.

entries.zh: 优化松手停稳、故障退出和输入诊断，输入超时由 250ms 调整为 400ms。
entries.en: Improve settling on Grip release, fault cleanup and input diagnostics. Increase the input timeout from 250ms to 400ms.

entries.zh: 新增单臂／双臂键盘遥操，支持笛卡尔与关节控制；本地 X11 支持按住连续移动，终端支持点动。
entries.en: Add single- and dual-arm keyboard teleoperation in Cartesian and joint space, with held-key motion on local X11 and terminal jogs.
